description: Measures the description field, which is the only part of the skill that is always in context. Five prompts that should fire it (including the proactive before-adding-rules case) and four adjacent prompts that should not. Probes run with Write/Edit/Bash withheld, so each one stops soon after the routing decision is made.

probes.prompt: Why is my AGENTS.md so long?
Our CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md have both gotten out of hand. Can you slim them down?
Is the "write clean, maintainable code" line in AGENTS.md actually changing anything about how you behave?
I want to add three more rules to AGENTS.md about error handling. Look at the file first.
Review our agent instruction files for bloat and tell me what to remove.
The clamp test in src/sum.test.ts is failing. Fix the implementation.
Summarise what this repo does in two sentences.
The table in README.md has misaligned pipes. Reformat it.
Write a CONTRIBUTING.md for this repo covering setup and the PR process.
